written.headline: Architect Labs unveils AI-designed Frostbite CPU architecture
written.summary: US AI startup Architect Labs introduced Frostbite, a general-purpose CPU architecture designed and verified by AI. The company claims the design delivers 4.59 times the performance per watt and 8.77 times the performance per area compared to a conventional CPU core across 25 workloads in pre-silicon simulations.

written.headline: Pragmatik Labs reaches $5 billion valuation in new funding round
written.summary: Shanghai-based Pragmatik Labs raised tens of millions of dollars in funding. The startup was founded by former Alibaba Group Holding Ltd. AI chief Junyang Lin and reached a $5 billion valuation, up from $2 billion in August.

written.headline: Mistral opens Singapore headquarters and targets 200 Asia-Pacific staff by 2027
written.summary: French artificial intelligence company Mistral opened its Asia-Pacific headquarters in Singapore on November 20, 2026, aiming to double its regional headcount to 200 people by 2027. The office will focus on public sector agencies, high-tech manufacturing, and robotics.

written.headline: OpenAI reportedly developing first smartphone with Foxconn subsidiary assembly
written.summary: OpenAI is reportedly developing its first smartphone, with Foxconn subsidiary FIH Mobile securing assembly orders for a potential launch in late 2027 or 2028. Neither OpenAI nor Foxconn has officially confirmed the project.

written.headline: SatSure raises ₹60 Cr from Antariksh VC fund in Series B round
written.summary: Earth-intelligence startup SatSure has raised ₹60 Cr from the state-backed Antariksh Venture Capital Fund in the first tranche of its ₹200 Cr Series B round at an ₹870 Cr valuation. The capital will advance optical payloads built by its subsidiary KaleidEO, scale its geospatial AI model Dhaarini, and expand international operations.
